title: Virtualization Primer
scenario: Welcome to Virtualization Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN): Logical segmentation of a switch at Layer 2. Isolates broadcast domains without physical separation. Tagged with 802.1Q on trunk ports. Native VLAN = untagged on trunk. Network Functions Virtualization (NFV): Virtualizes network appliances (firewalls, load balancers, routers) as software on commodity hardware. Reduces physical appliance costs. Often paired with SDN in modern data centers. Software-Defined Networking (SDN): Decouples control plane from data plane. Centralized controller (northbound API to apps, southbound to devices via OpenFlow). Enables programmable, automated network management.
question: What does VLAN stand for?
explanation: VLAN stands for Virtual Local Area Network.
